holder-quote: She headed upstairs, missing Daly. He was sitting so still he was invisible. And he had a Skill.
The young [Axe Warrior] and soon-to-be [Carpenter] nodded slowly.
Daly paused, about to go out after the others. He beckoned at Siri, and she and the rest of the team followed him. The [Axe Warrior] spoke as he led them in a brisk walk.
The [Axe Warrior] resisted the urge to scratch at his bites or stare at his skin.
